name: Orbit
tagline: Turns any waste material into three product ideas with build instructions, 3D previews and impact estimates.

awards: Best Future of our Planet Hack

problem: Most waste is never recycled, and upcycling is hard to start; the team cites a 6.9% recycling figure.
solution: The user names a material; the system proposes three concepts with materials, tools and feasibility, then generates instructions, an editable 3D model and an environmental impact wireframe.
demo_moment: Team-described: enter old jeans and get a buildable product with a 3D preview.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Future of our Planet Hack” among 124 submissions.
Goes from idea to instructions and impact numbers.

lessons: Make a sustainability tool end in something the user can actually build.
